translation: A ⟨word⟩ of falsehood ⟨את⟩ the righteous ⟨hates⟩, but a wicked person ⟨causes⟩ stench ⟨and⟩ becomes ⟨ashamed⟩.

tokens.rationale: davar — a matter, thing, word; English requires article and context
sheker — an untruth, sham, deception; idiomatic rendering
yisn'eh — verb requires explicit subject in English
tzadik — just one; English requires article and plural form
verasha' — conjunction + wicked one; English requires article and noun
yevayish — literally 'makes stink'; idiom for moral offensiveness
veyachpír — root means 'to blush' or 'be ashamed'; requires copula
